Rehfeldt, M., Bussmann, S., Fleiter, T. (Fraunhofer ISI) and Rissman, J. (Energy Innovation) (2024). Direct electrification of industrial process heat: An assessment of technologies, potentials and future prospects for the EU. Study on behalf of Agora Industry, Berlin, Version 1.1, June 2024 (publication 329/04-S-2024/EN). The report asks to be cited as "Fraunhofer ISI (2024)". No DOI printed.

Region: EU-27 (2019 energy data; technology status 2023 with 2035 outlook). Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed page). Main file: eight technology fact sheets (Tables 2-9, Sect. 3.1: electric boilers, heat pumps, resistance, induction, plasma torches, EAF, shock-wave heating, combined thermal storage) loaded as a 2023 process and an expected-2035 process (maximum temperature, heating efficiency, capacity; TRL on the 2023 row); 2025 and 2030 columns only where they differ are in other-values. Also Table 14 natural gas boiler and furnace references, dielectric and infrared fact sheets (Tables 10-11), and Chapter 4 specific energy consumption by application (GJ/t fuel and electricity) for steel (BF/BOF, hydrogen DRI, EAF, rolling, annealing), chemicals (steam cracking, adipic acid, polycarbonate, soda, carbon black, ammonia syngas), glass, lime, cement, kraft pulp and paper. Not loaded: the study contains NO capex, opex or lifetime data (it refers to Agora Energiewende 2022 Transformationskostenrechner); laser and electron-beam fact sheets are in other-values; sector electrification potentials (Figs 19-31) are chart-based and skipped. Traps: table numbers in the contents list are shifted against the printed fact-sheet labels (labels used here); heat pump efficiency 150-600 % is COP x 100; plasma efficiency is 50-90 % in the fact sheet but 50-95 % in the text; capacities for the boiler (75 MW) and EAF (200 MW) are maxima; the reference product of the H2-DRI numbers (per t DRI or per t steel) is not stated; the furnace-efficiency column of Table 14 was not loaded (ambiguous layout). Most Chapter 4 numbers are reprinted from Fleiter et al. 2023b and other works.
